material:
name: triage
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
permissions:
  issues: write
jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Greet reporter
        run: |
          echo "Thanks for ${{ github.event.issue.number }}"
          echo "Title: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}"
      - name: Safe env use
        env:
          BODY: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
        run: echo "$BODY" | wc -c
      - name: Notify
        run: |
          curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.SLACK_TOKEN }}" https://hooks.example.invalid/x
